chain: Ethereum primary; also Arbitrum, Base, Avalanche

risk_flags.message: NAV is an on-chain read of an issuer-set value written to SharePriceCalculator; it is not an ERC-4626 conversion or reserve-derived NAV.
Primary redemption is unavailable to U.S. persons; their only exit is the secondary market.
Ethereum primary redemption pays sUSDe, not USDC; a clean-dollar exit requires an additional Ethena cooldown or DEX swap.
Report-derived attachment point is 9.66%, below the 10% institutional norm; it thinned because senior supply grew, not because the junior layer shrank.

peg.nav_basis: admin-written on SharePriceCalculator; on-chain read of an issuer-set value delivered through the NAV oracle write path, not a vault conversion
peg.market_price_source: CoinGecko API external aggregate mid for re-protocol-reusd; off-chain market-data API, not an on-chain read and not the issuer API
peg.premium_discount_basis: signed (external market mid - on-chain issuer-set NAV) / NAV * 100
peg.history_basis_note: The current theoretical-price endpoint is the on-chain SharePriceCalculator NAV used by this tile. Earlier exported observations retain Re Protocol API NAV values because no historical on-chain SharePriceCalculator reads were available for restatement; consumers must not treat the legacy portion as independently on-chain verified.

liquidity.total_tvl_basis: GeckoTerminal pool reserves collected 2026-09-16T07:56:07Z for the four active reported Ethereum venues plus the zero-volume sUSG/reUSD pool; pool TVL is not executable depth
liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: TOTAL impact against the route's $1,000 venue-spot reference — the smallest rung, whose own spread is excluded; see fill_ratio for all-in. The 200bps crossing is bracketed between $10,000,000 (clears at -16.5bps) and $20,000,000 (-4676.6bps). The published $10,000,000 figure is the conservative last-clearing rung, not an interpolated crossing.
liquidity.volume_24h_scope: GeckoTerminal Ethereum pools listed in pools[]
liquidity.external_mid_source: CoinGecko API external aggregate mid for re-protocol-reusd

exit_mark.fair_value_basis: external CoinGecko market mark captured by peg tracker
exit_mark.slippage_bps_basis: PRICE IMPACT against this venue's own smallest quoted rung, which EXCLUDES that rung's own spread — it is not the holder's all-in cost. The all-in figure is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Impact is measured this way deliberately, so peg discount and source lag do not leak into it.

primary_exit.eligibility: Non-U.S. persons who pass protocol KYC/KYB only; U.S. persons cannot use primary redemption
primary_exit.capacity: Tiered: instant buffer subject to capacity and daily/per-wallet limits; quarterly queue after buffer exhaustion
primary_exit.note: For U.S. holders the only exit is secondary. On Ethereum, even an eligible primary redeemer receives sUSDe rather than clean dollars.

pools.name: Curve reUSD/USDC
pools.note: Not used as the market-price source; the repository curve_pool strategy has a known cross-decimal scaling bug for 18-decimal reUSD versus 6-decimal USDC.

liquidity.note: No CEX listing. Depth is marginal price impact against an external mid. No balance_ratio is published, so the twocrypto exchange-rate/imbalance ambiguity is not introduced.
liquidity.slippage_bps_basis: PRICE IMPACT against this venue's own smallest quoted rung, which EXCLUDES that rung's own spread — it is not the holder's all-in cost. The all-in figure is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Impact is measured this way deliberately, so peg discount and source lag do not leak into it.

backing.as_of_basis: Ethereum block time for supply/NAV; DefiLlama Re TVL carries its own daily observation timestamp
backing.collateral_ratio_basis: No collateral ratio is established. The on-chain share price and token supply measure issuer-valued claims, not reserve coverage; Re's reserve dashboard combines reUSD and reUSDe and does not expose an asset-attributed denominator suitable for a reUSD collateral ratio.
backing.total_backing_basis: Not published because no independently attributable reUSD-only reserve total was established.
backing.nav_claim_value_basis: Ethereum reUSD totalSupply() multiplied by SharePriceCalculator.getSharePrice(); this is claim value, not backing.

protocol_reserves_passthrough.scope: issuer-reported combined reUSD + reUSDe reserves; not attributable to reUSD alone
protocol_reserves_passthrough.source_quantity: DefiLlama Re totalLiquidityUSD (TVL), not Re's former issuer reserve table
protocol_reserves_passthrough.basis: DefiLlama's Re adapter sums configured tokens in Re custody, redemption, and ICL addresses across four chains, plus Re's Avalanche off-chain-assets oracle recorded by the adapter as USDC.

backing.attachment_point_basis: $20.0M loss-waterfall junior layer divided by the then-current senior denominator; this is the treaty-subordinated waterfall layer, NOT the approximately $77M product-page balance-sheet capital figure. They are different quantities, not competing snapshots.
backing.attachment_point_direction: thinned because the denominator rose, not because the junior layer shrank

integrity.note: Supply and issuer-set NAV are measured on-chain. Reserve composition is issuer-reported, protocol-wide, and lacks a source data timestamp; it is not used to claim reUSD coverage.

upstream.name: Re Protocol SharePriceCalculator / NAV oracle write path
upstream.note: The value is stored on-chain but computed/written through an issuer-controlled oracle path; it is not reserve-derived.

upstream.name: Ethena sUSDe
upstream.metric: 51.05% of DefiLlama-computed combined Re TVL and Ethereum redemption payout asset
upstream.note: The reserve percentage is combined reUSD + reUSDe and must not be read as a reUSD-only allocation.

upstream.name: Off-chain reinsurance trusts and counterparties
upstream.note: Not independently measurable from Ethereum state.
